items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing cost efficiencies and capital discipline supporting strong free cash flow potential despite lower lithium prices.

items.headline: Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: 2026 outlook scenarios tied to lithium market pricing; sales volumes expected in the range of 225 to 235 kilotons lithium carbonate equivalent, as increased Wodgina volumes partially offset a delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due to a fire that occurred on June 9.
